reason: I'd ask for the free sample, sure, but I'm not putting a 23-euro litre on the list before I've tasted it in a drink and know how much sugar is actually in it. My guests order a virgin mojito or a ti-punch style thing, so a 'Koso' has to earn its spot before the next quarterly cost review, not after.
objection: At 23 euros a litre it costs two or three times my usual syrups, and I don't know yet if it's really less sweet or if guests will even order something with a name they've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: The sample tasting well in two or three of my own mocktails, plus the sugar per litre on paper, so I can show the owner it's a healthier base that sells at a premium.
